title: What I learned making about 500 low poly game assets with AI-written Blender scripts, and the bugs only real engine tests caught
author: Big-Communication950
selftext:
I make low poly 3D game assets, and the whole pipeline runs on Python scripts for Blender that I write with AI help (Claude). I describe a model and how it should look, the script builds it from code, I check the renders and we fix what looks wrong. That has given me about 500 models so far, each with LODs, a shared palette texture, and colliders where they make sense.



The speed was the easy part. The biggest lesson was that a model can look perfect in a render and still be broken for the person who downloads it. So I started testing the way a buyer would: open the real zip, unpack it into a brand-new Unity or Godot project, and run an automatic check on every model. It looks for missing textures, pink materials, bad colliders and broken animations, and it drops every physics prop on the ground.



That found bugs I had never seen in my renders. Thin props like books and keys fell straight through the floor in Unity, because they moved too fast for normal collision checks. Wind shaders made for URP showed red errors in projects without URP. In Godot, a .blend file left in the folder could stop the import, and animated models had picked up clips from other models. My songbird had a cow's walk animation! Clips also did not loop in Godot until I fixed the names.



None of this was hard to fix once a test showed it. AI got me to a big pile of assets very fast, but it could not tell me if they really worked in an engine until I built a way to check.



If you want to look at the results, I made a free 16-model sample pack for Godot, Unity and Unreal. It is free for commercial use and needs no sign-up. The page also links to my paid packs, so you know before you click. Unreal is the one engine I have not tested yet.

[https://soresa-assets.itch.io/free-stylized-nature](https://soresa-assets.itch.io/free-stylized-nature)



How do you test AI-made assets or code before other people use them? And what would you want me to check that I have missed?
